label: Legacy artifact identifiers
rule: Replace legacy artifact identifiers with the public ID given in AIDCF-002 section 41.
condition: "AIDCF-016" is rewritten to AIDCF-VR-001 only where it denotes the Full-Stack Validation Report (AIDCF-002 section 41)
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)

label: Legacy assurance levels
rule: Map legacy A2 to A5 one-to-one to AL2 to AL5 (registries/vocabularies/assurance-levels.csv legacyAlias). The original value is kept in provenance.legacyValue and a MigrationRecord is produced (TDS-REQ-044)
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)

label: Legacy control results
rule: Replace each legacy control-result code with the canonicalCode of its row in registries/vocabularies/control-result-aliases.csv. The original value is kept in provenance.legacyValue and a MigrationRecord is produced (TDS-REQ-044)
condition: Apply the condition column of the matching alias row
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)

label: Legacy decision codes
rule: Replace each legacy decision code using registries/vocabularies/decision-aliases.csv; the field column states whether it maps to decisionState or decisionLifecycle. The original value is kept in provenance.legacyValue and a MigrationRecord is produced (TDS-REQ-044)
condition: A legacy NOT ASSESSED decision maps to no decision state: no decision is issued
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)

label: Legacy evidence-system conformance levels
rule: Map evidence-system conformance E0 to E5 (former AIDCF-008 section 4) to EC0 to EC5 (registries/vocabularies/evidence-system-conformance-levels.csv). The original value is kept in provenance.legacyValue and a MigrationRecord is produced (TDS-REQ-044)
condition: Only where the legacy code denotes an evidence-system conformance level (CCM-REQ-031)
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)

label: Legacy evidence grades
rule: Map the AIDCF-005/AIDCF-006 evidence grade E0 to E5 to quality band Q0 to Q5 (AIDCF-008 section 19; registries/vocabularies/evidence-quality-bands.csv). The original value is kept in provenance.legacyValue and a MigrationRecord is produced (TDS-REQ-044)
condition: Only where the legacy code denotes an evidence grade; E1 to E7 evidence classes are unchanged (CCM-REQ-031)
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)

label: Legacy lifecycle stages
rule: Map AIDCF-003 lifecycle stages to the canonical stage named in registries/vocabularies/lifecycle-stages.csv legacyStages. The original value is kept in provenance.legacyValue and a MigrationRecord is produced (TDS-REQ-044)
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)

label: Legacy relationship names
rule: Replace each legacy relationship name with its canonical type (AIDCF-014 section 9.1; registries/vocabularies/relationship-aliases.csv), reversing source and target where the direction rule says so (TDS-REQ-040). The original value is kept in provenance.legacyValue and a MigrationRecord is produced (TDS-REQ-044)
condition: Direction change as stated for the alias
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)

label: AIDCF-015 v1.2 evidence-class words
rule: Evidence-class words (CONFIGURATION, OPERATIONAL, VALIDATION, DOCUMENTARY) become E-codes, with the original kept in provenance.legacyValue (AIDCF-016 section 14).
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)

label: AIDCF-015 v1.2 synthetic identifiers
rule: Synthetic records move to the urn:aidcf:syn: namespace; the predecessor identifier is kept only as the target of MIGRATED_FROM with the MigrationRecord as migrationRef (AIDCF-016 section 14, MDM-REQ-008, MDM-REQ-053).
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)

label: Recomputed results
rule: Every Gate Result is recomputed under the canonical roll-up (AIDCF-016 section 9.2) with registry roles; each change is a RESULT_REINTERPRETATION mapping that states the rule applied, and the previous value is not overwritten in the previous release (MDM-REQ-053).
condition: A result whose evidence is below the profile floor becomes UNKNOWN
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)

label: Deprecation instead of deletion
rule: A new schema set does not delete a class, property or code used by the previous set; it deprecates it (owl:deprecated true with a pointer to its replacement) and publishes a MigrationRecord with fromId, toId, changeType and rationale (MDM-REQ-052; TDS-REQ-054).
fallback: No defined mapping: the value becomes UNKNOWN with a migration reason (TDS-REQ-075)
